name: Rune-Inscribed Parchment
summary: At the Valley of Trials, Gornek gives new shamans Rune-Inscribed Parchment, a summons from Shikrik. It begins their training in communion with spirits and the elements.

sections.title: A Summons from the Spirits
sections.body: New orc shamans prove they can survive against local wildlife. Then Gornek, who oversees the Valley of Trials, gives them a rune-inscribed summons. Shikrik, the valley's shaman trainer, wrote its mystical message and asks to meet each newly arrived initiate.

sections.title: The Path of the Shaman
sections.body: Meeting Shikrik begins a shaman's sacred duty to the Horde. She teaches that shamans serve as conduits for ancestral spirits and wield the wrath of the elements. Under her guidance, new shamans learn to channel spiritual energies, mend wounds, and call on Kalimdor's natural forces.

faq.answer: Gornek gives new shamans in the Valley of Trials a written summons to seek formal instruction from Shikrik, their trainer.
Shikrik wrote the message. She trains shamans near the dens in the Valley of Trials and awaits those chosen to guide their people spiritually.

faq.q: Where do I take the parchment?
faq.answer: You take the parchment a short walk within the Valley of Trials. Shikrik waits beneath the red crags to train orc and troll shamans.

faq.q: Why was my character chosen to receive it?
faq.answer: Shikrik says those drawn to shamanism are chosen to serve as conduits for the ancestors and speak with the world's elemental forces.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the parchment?
faq.answer: Shikrik accepts you as her student. She introduces you to elemental magic, communion with ancestors, and the basics of healing and combat.

faq.q: Can any class complete this quest?
faq.answer: Only new shamans receive the Rune-Inscribed Parchment. Other classes receive distinct summons to their own trainers.

angles.text: As a shaman, this parchment marks your first step on a spiritual path. It binds you to the spirits and Durotar's raw elements.
As an orc, your return to shamanism honors Draenor's ancestral traditions. The Old Horde's demonic corruption nearly extinguished them.
As a Darkspear troll, you bring your natural communion with spirits and reverence for ancestors into the Horde's shared shamanic traditions.
